facts.fact: 两人共骑Astorath东行一小时把Relystone甩在身后（达拉胸腹贴着罗莉后背、环臂握缰，罗莉心乱、责怪自己不够冷静），借树林遮挡血衣、躲开炽天使的窥视。
facts.anchor: We made quick work of putting the village of Relystone behind us, riding an hour to the east. The trees surrounding the village provided us with coverage from the seraphs spying our bloody forms.

facts.fact: 线人那边没有新收获：他也只听过走私人类的传闻、没亲眼见过；今后他会努力查证传闻真伪，并联络其他几个村庄的炽天使熟人留意——若人类真被运进Tironaill，被发觉只是时间问题。
facts.anchor: Unfortunately, nothing more than we already know. He, too, has heard the rumors but has seen nothing himself. I’m sorry.” My shoulders slumped. “From here on out, he is going to be diligently working to figure out if the rumors are true and contact seraphs he knows in several other villages to be on the lookout.

facts.fact: 罗莉问起昨天看到的法术，达拉自述两项：fragorkinesis——能在他人或物体内部制造任意大小的爆炸；umbrakinesis——操纵并把暗影/黑暗固化；他还低声说自己的法术不止两个。
facts.anchor: “Fragorkinesis. I can make explosions of any size inside others and objects,” he stated matter-of-factly. “And yes, I can manipulate and solidify shadows and darkness. It’s called umbrakinesis.”

facts.fact: 达拉说这些法术都不常见——他是百年来已知唯一的umbrakinesis；又说自己并非城堡里唯一有超过两个法术的人，国王喜欢把强大炽天使聚在身边为己所用。
facts.anchor: “They’re not. I am the only known umbrakinesis in a century.”

facts.fact: 罗莉鼓起勇气问达拉是否读过她的灵光（aura），他承认读过（「不读就不算称职的卫队长」）；灵光能透露性格、倾向、有时是健康，对炽天使还能看出法术种类、只在启动该法术时可见；但他从不读幼童——幼童灵光成年才定型、变化太频繁读不准，所以没读过科拉。
facts.anchor: I worked up the nerve to ask, “Have you read my aura?” I could almost feel his mouth tug into a smile.

facts.fact: 达拉透露王权真相：国王托里什（Torrish）从Themis那里获得直接的力量线、联系是共生的、彼此输送力量——这是他「保住」王位的原因。
facts.anchor: It is why he stays king. Torrish’s connection with Themis is symbiotic. They get power from each other.

facts.fact: 神明靠崇拜与虔诚获得更多力量；Tironaill除Themis外没有任何神像、祭坛或神庙（安雅说这被禁止，达拉说这是刻意设计）；罗莉由此联想到angheal不育，猜测他们生不出孩子是因为不再敬奉生命女神，达拉只答「这是一种假说」。
facts.anchor: Then you know that deities derive more power from worship and devotion. How many other statues, altars, or temples of deities other than Themis have you seen in Tironaill?

facts.fact: 罗莉悟出献祭的实质：Themis要求血与赎罪——犯错炽天使被送交atoner（赎罪官）受罚即「正义得偿」，这喂养着正义之神的力量；此前达拉还说Torrish保住王冠「还需要献祭」，说到此处他咬肌抽动、绷紧不肯多说。
facts.anchor: “Blood,” I whispered. “Themis requires blood and atonement. Seraphs are sent to the atoner to be punished for wrongdoing, which would be considered justice served. It feeds the power of the God of Justice.”

facts.fact: 还没来得及追问，森林边缘出现了一座房屋——达拉神色怅然地说「我们到了」，被问「这是哪儿」时他叹气答：「家」。
facts.anchor: I was left with far more questions than answers. Before I could push further, a home on the edge of the forest appeared.
